summary_en: MS&AD Insurance Group Holdings authorized acquisition of up to 52 million shares (3.7% of outstanding shares excluding treasury stock) for a maximum of 135 billion yen from November 20, 2026 to March 24, 2027, raising total buyback authorization for FY2026 from 270 billion yen to 325 billion yen following upward revision of profit guidance.
title_en: Notice Regarding Determination of Matters Concerning Acquisition of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief:
MS&AD Insurance Group Holdings resolved on November 19, 2026 to acquire up to 52 million shares of its own common stock for a maximum of 135 billion yen through market purchase between November 20, 2026 and March 24, 2027. This acquisition represents 3.7% of the company's outstanding shares excluding treasury stock as of September 30, 2026 (1,423,204,315 shares).

The new authorization increases the total buyback program for fiscal year 2026 from 270 billion yen to 325 billion yen. This increase follows an upward revision of the company's adjusted profit forecast. The earlier authorization of 190 billion yen, announced on May 20, 2026, was completed and terminated on November 2, 2026. The company executes treasury stock acquisitions as part of its ongoing capital allocation policy to enhance shareholder returns and capital efficiency, with specific timing and amounts determined by the Board of Directors based on market conditions and business environment.
